ECE 685 | Power Systems Design L25
Line Parameters IV
Calculate one verified R-X-B record from conductor and
tower data
Buxin She
Mike Wiegers Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

Lecture outline
Start with the tower: identify each circuit, its three phases, and the members of each
phase bundle. Then build one 𝑅, 𝑋, 𝐵 record per phase of each circuit.
1 Configuration: read the tower and distinguish phases, bundles, and circuits.
2 Resistance: use shared phase voltage and current division.
3 Inductance and capacitance: include shared magnetic and electric fields.
4 Route record: form physical totals, then convert to per unit.
5 Exercises: assemble and check a complete bundle record.
Produce one consistent 𝑅, 𝑋, 𝐵 record for a bundled phase without confusing member
count and circuit count.
